title: Scalar restriction on the full complete subcategory
statement: Let l be a prime, S any scheme, and fix the derived localizations of [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models]. Write F=diagonalCompletedUnderlying(l,S), the exact restriction from the derived category of modules over the actual completed Z_l sheaf to the derived category of constant Z_l-module sheaves [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit]. Let P consist of the completed-coefficient objects M such that for every constant-coefficient derived object V with l times its identity invertible, Hom(V,F(M)) is a subsingleton (equivalently zero). Then the composite of the full-subcategory inclusion P.ι with F is fully faithful. There is no geometric finiteness or l-invertibility assumption on S. No trace object or direct-image presentation occurs.

source.place: full faithfulness from complete completed coefficients to constant coefficients

proof.text: Use diagonalCompletionCoefficientTransport to identify the actual completed and constant derived coefficient categories with the small-site constant-completion categories, with a natural isomorphism of the actual scalar functor.

Transport orthogonality through the additive constant-category equivalence. By constantPrincipalComplete_of_orthogonal this implies local completeness of the restricted object. The flat-ringed restriction criterion and the equality of the extended residue kernel with the first completed residue kernel imply local completeness of the completed object.

Lift the given full subcategory into the complete completed-coefficient subcategory. Compose this fully faithful lift with ConstantCompletion.equivalence and the full inclusion of the complete constant objects. Its ambient functor is naturally isomorphic to the given scalar functor followed by the constant-category equivalence. Full faithfulness is invariant under natural isomorphism and reflected after composition with a faithful functor.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalCompleteScalarRestriction (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (S : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S] :
    let F := diagonalCompletedUnderlying l S
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (DiagonalCompleted l S)) := fun M ↦
      ∀ V : DerivedCategory (DiagonalMod l S),
        IsIso (l • 𝟙 V) → Subsingleton (V ⟶ F.obj M)
    Nonempty (P.ι ⋙ F).FullyFaithful
